themes.title: Populist Right Battles Media Bias and Digital Censorship
themes.blurb: Conservative and right-wing political figures in Sweden and the United States are raising alarms over media coverage and platform moderation. While Swedish Democrats protest exclusion from local online public forums, US leaders threaten regulatory actions and boycotts against hostile media outlets.

themes.title: Debates Intensify Over Far-Right Normalization and Executive Power
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist movements in both Sweden and the US face growing scrutiny and institutional pushback as they expand their influence. Opponents raise alarms over the normalization of far-right politics and executive overreach, while leaders work to consolidate legitimacy through public forums and policy initiatives.
